title: ZnO/Al2O3/CuO ternary nanocomposites: a bandgap-engineered solution for high-efficiency photocatalytic hydrogen generation
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00191A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Krishna Daware, Mayuri Khade, Sonali Mhaske, Yogesh Sethi, Prashant Bankar, Ratna Chauhan, Suresh W. Gosavi
ZnO/Al2O3/CuO nanocomposites, synthesized hydrothermally, showed bandgap narrowing and efficient heterojunctions, boosting visible-light absorption and charge separation for enhanced photocatalytic hydrogen production.
